title: Amplitude-weighted stride permutation entropy: uncertain incremental prediction across public gait collections
abstract: Amplitude-weighted stride permutation entropy did not demonstrate incremental Parkinson/control prediction over an unweighted-entropy and conventional gait baseline: second-collection logloss 0.408163 versus 0.421726, delta +0.013562, joint-bootstrap95% interval [-0.033772,0.121618]. Adaptive dataset reuse and unknown participant overlap prevent untouched independent confirmation.
